item.title: GoGoGrandparent (YC S16) is hiring back end engineers
item.description:
📝 What gets us excited now (and what we’re hiring for) is that technically this ‘self-management problem’ doesn’t just stop at rides. People have known this for a long time and that’s inspired a lot of the solutions that older adults currently have. GoGo is working to make sure that losing your youth doesn’t mean losing your independence.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gogograndparent/jobs/2vbzAw8-gogograndparent-yc-s16-is-hiring-backend-and-full-stack-engineers

item.title: Why didn't AI “join the workforce” in 2025?
item.description:
📝 The industry had reason to be optimistic that 2025 would prove pivotal. It seemed natural that this same skill might easily generalize to other types of tasks. Mark Benioff, CEO of Salesforce, became so enthusiastic about these possibilities that early in 2025, he claimed that AI agents would imminently unleash a “digital labor revolution” worth trillions of dollars.
🔗 Read more: https://calnewport.com/why-didnt-ai-join-the-workforce-in-2025/

item.title: Show HN: OSS sustain guard – Sustainability signals for OSS dependencies
item.description:
📝 Why OSS Sustain Guard. 💡 Project Philosophy¶ OSS Sustain Guard uses empathetic language and contextual metrics to help teams support the projects they rely on. Sustainable by design: Respects open-source sustainability models with funding awareness for community-driven projects.
